svg.title: Summing the sixteen ordered pairs (a, b) gives 32 −8 = 24. The two scalar labels retain their 1/4 factors, the cross Wick contractions their multiplicity two and the color sum its dim g. The recovered coefficient is therefore (1/4)2 2 24D(x)2 dim g, exactly 3 dim g/(π4|x|8) with the source normalization. This transports the finite calculation used in TR2 with no new stress or Gaussian normalization. For ρ > 1 set Z(ρ) = ρ−8 log2 ρ and νρ = Z(ρ)(p 7→p/ρ)∗μΘ. These are positive Lorentz- invariant cone measures, and TR2 yields Z e−sp0dνρ = Z(ρ)E(s/ρ) −→AGs−8 (s > 0), (TR6)
